en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 9.6.
Sahetukaduka, etc., Kusalattika (Wholesome Triplet)
Dependent on a state that is neither-rooted nor wholesome, a state that is neither-rooted nor wholesome arises by way of root-condition:
dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt or accompanied by restlessness, mind-originated matter [arises];
dependent on one great primary, three great primaries [arise] … dependent on two great primaries … dependent on a state that is neither-rooted nor wholesome, a state that is rootless [arises].
An unwholesome state arises by way of root condition: in dependence on delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, there arise the associated aggregates;
at the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on the [heart-]base, there arise the aggregates accompanied by roots.
In dependence on a state that is neither-rooted nor wholesome, there arise states that are neither-rooted nor wholesome and states that are neither-rooted nor unwholesome.
States arise with the root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-rooted nor wholesome, a state that is neither-rooted nor wholesome arises with the root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is not accompanied by roots and is unwholesome, and a state that is neither-rooted nor wholesome, a state that is not accompanied by roots and is unwholesome arises with the root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to root-cause: nine; with respect to object: six; with respect to predominance: five …pe… with respect to non-disappearance: nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither-with-root-cause nor unwholesome, there arises a state that is neither-with-root-cause nor unwholesome by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither-rootless nor unwholesome, there arises a state that is neither-rootless nor unwholesome by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is neither with root-cause nor unwholesome and a state that is neither with root-cause nor unwholesome, a state that is neither with root-cause nor unwholesome arises by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are nine;

under object-condition, four; under predominance-condition, five … pe … under mutuality-condition, six … pe … under prenascence and repetition-conditions, two … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither with root-cause nor indeterminate, a state that is neither with root-cause nor indeterminate arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor indeterminate, there arises a state that is neither-root nor indeterminate by way of root condition.

Dependent on states that are both not-with-root and not-indeterminate, and states that are neither-root and not-indeterminate, there arises a state that is neither-root nor indeterminate by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: three;
under object: five; under predominance: one ... pe ... under non-disappearance: five.
(The "Associated with Cause" dyad is similar to the "With Cause" dyad.)
